findings.title: The explicit tree in Lemma 72 Case II can restrict Player II and invalidate strategy transfer

locations.item: Lemma 72, Case II, explicit Q and subsequent selection of II-winning strategy
Forward implication of Theorem 69 and comprehension (5.2)

findings.source_claim: Q={q: some prefix lies in P or q lies in T(C_i,n)} is an I-quasistrategy; an I-winning strategy in the restricted W_i,n(P) game would win unrestricted.
findings.complete_check: Report Sections 3.2-3.3: Gamma_even=Sigma^0_2, Gamma_odd=Pi^0_2; A0=[1], C0=[0] union [1,0], C0,n=C0, all other layers empty. W=[1,0], P={q extending (1,0)}=Phi(empty)=Phi(P); empty not in P. H_0,0=C0 is I-winning via move 0. Q=T(C0) contains (1) but excludes (1,1), restricting II. Unrestricted W game is II-winning; restricted game is I-winning via move 1.
assumptions_verified: Recursive clopen sets in required definable effectively treeable paired dual classes
Disjoint layers, constant increasing closed decomposition and layered compatibility
Explicit fixed point, not an assumed parameter
One-stage relation also meets printed stage convention in this example
Case II holds, starting position outside P
Q is pruned; immediate-loss convention used exactly
findings.counterevidence: A genuine I-winning H strategy exists (first move 0), but that does not make the explicitly defined Q an I-quasistrategy. Lemma 72 final assertion survives the example. Labels do not change the membership formula.
findings.core_dependency: Lemma 72 completes Theorem 69 forward implication (3)=>(1), and is used in the comprehension assertion (5.2).
findings.impact: Demonstrated invalid core derivation; no counterexample to the determinacy theorem statement, first reduction theorem or whole classification program.

repair.statement: Use D of actual I-winning H positions, retain histories whose intermediate positions stay in D, and after I exits use a II-winning H escape phase until leaving T(C). Countably select auxiliary strategies using stated strategic replacement/treeability.
repair.boundary: Checks local strategy construction; full weak-theory formalization, reversals and downstream applications remain for separate acceptance. Author adoption not requested or observed.

scope_clarifications.reason: Notation clarification; later construction indicates consistent orientation, and F01 uses a one-stage fixed point independent of this.

unresolved_claims: Full weak-theory formalization of repair and subsequent uses
No whole-paper correctness or falsity conclusion
Limited erratum search cannot establish absence of all corrections

independent_acceptance_check.scope: Focused acceptance of existing F01 and the stated local strategy repair, excluding a new full formalization.

checks.result: For A0=[1], C0=[0] union [1,0], the explicit fixed point P is the extensions of (1,0), and root is outside P. All clopen, dual pointclass, layer, stage and illegal-move conventions are met. Q contains (1) but omits (1,1), so it restricts II. Unrestricted W is II-winning but restricted W is I-winning.

Source p54 explicitly uses Lemmas71?72 for Theorem69 and (5.2). The repaired all-intermediate-I-winning-position tree leaves II unrestricted; the escape phase and countable strategy choice are correctly stated. No complete RCA0 formalization or false final theorem is claimed.

independent_acceptance_check.result: F01 remains Major; demonstrated core derivation defect with bounded mathematical repair.
